instruction: You are facing towards the white color cupboards in front of you, turn right, go straight, turn left, go straight, there is an open door in front of you, go straight and exit the door, turn left, go straight, there is a staircase on the left side, go straight, there is a railing on the left side, go straight, now you are facing towards the wall which has photo frames on it, turn right, go straight, now you are facing the wall which has a photo frame on it, turn left, go straight, turn right, now you are inside the bedroom, go straight, turn right, go straight and enter the washroom and stand beside the open door, stop there, this is your final destination.
